history_policy: This version hash-inherits every V31 workload, representation, width, quick/full job count, quick/full checksum, execution mode, scored operation, attribution counter, mixed-tier replay signature, timing boundary, occupancy rule, native runner, and publication ruling. It changes no production engine behavior. It adds only a duration-qualified publication tier for the four required-bytecode/no-JIT arithmetic workloads. Any later workload, boundary, jobs, checksum, metric source, adapter, integration ruling, or acceptance change creates another version.
change: Adds a duration-qualified publication tier to the four required-bytecode/no-JIT arithmetic workloads after the unchanged 10,000-job structural tier proved shorter than reliable process-energy counter resolution. The publication tier preserves identical source, Context options, warmup, required-bytecode/no-native admission, attribution semantics, controls, and exact-parent gates.

publication_tier.rationale: The unchanged 10,000-job structural rows can complete below reliable process-energy resolution. Public efficiency evidence uses enough identical logical work for every required counter while retaining the ordinary five-percent RSD, nominal-thermal, AC-power, exact-parent, and no-discard gates.

no_jit_integration.publication_boundary: V32 preserves every V31 required-bytecode mode, source, Context option, warmup, quick/full job count and checksum, attribution value, quickening contract, measured-boundary occupancy rule, binary-provenance rule, allocation replay, and control. Only the exact-parent publication invocation uses the frozen 500,000-job tier; shorter counter-quantized rows remain diagnostic.
